name: Coffee Circle
description: German online coffee roaster shop selling beans, ground coffee, capsules and brewing equipment such as grinders, kettles, scales and espresso machines. Its shipping page lists delivery to Germany and about 30 other European destinations, shipped with DHL.
description_es: Tienda online alemana de café que vende café en grano y molido, cápsulas y equipos de preparación como molinillos, hervidores, balanzas y cafeteras espresso. Su página de envíos indica entrega a Alemania y a unos 30 destinos europeos más, con DHL.

ships_to.notes: Germany is listed on the shipping page among 32 destinations. Parcels can be sent to a DHL Packstation or post office branch in Germany. No German regional limits stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: No store pickup is described on the shipping page. Delivery to a DHL Packstation or post office is offered in Germany.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Shopify store. Product names and descriptions are in German. Free shipping is marked on some products.

sources.supports: product range: coffee and brewing equipment
delivery countries including Germany, DHL, Packstation delivery
